_source: Ministry of General Education (Western Province), 'Physical Education Grade 10 to Grade 12 Common Schemes of Work' (2018) -- Grade 12, all three terms. This is a province-wide common scheme of work, not an individual teacher's own document, and covers all three terms of Grade 12 in full. The source has no numeric topic or sub-topic codes of its own (its own table columns are simply 'TOPIC' and 'SUB-TOPIC' in plain text); this app has assigned its own PE12.x / PE12.x.x numbering, consistent with how every other OBC subject in this app is coded, purely as a structural key -- every topic name, sub-topic name, and Specific Outcome statement is the source's own real wording (its own 'Content' Knowledge/Skill/Value columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled OBC subject). Term placement for every topic here is real, read directly from which Grade/Term block of the source document it appears in -- unlike several other OBC subjects in this app, no part of this file's term placement is a non-sourced organizational guess. Where the same topic and sub-topic recur across several consecutive weeks of the source with closely related specific outcomes (a normal feature of a week-by-week scheme), those weeks' outcomes have been consolidated under that one sub-topic rather than repeated week by week.
